quest.title: One Ship, Two Ships, Three Ships...
quest.description: Linling forgot to count the number of ships docked at the port yesterday, and it's been troubling her...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Shoot, I can't remember... Two — no, four, plus... seven...? Nope, that wasn't it...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Ugh! This is such a waste of my time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you counting?

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: I'm totaling up the number of boats that came into and went out of the docks yesterday... If I get the wrong figures again I'll never hear the end of it!

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: I was so busy writing poetry yesterday that I totally forgot about it... and now I'm rushing to get this done at the last minute.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: I hate doing this. How do they expect me to keep track when there's an endless stream of ships going in and out of the docks all day long? For each one I note down there's another that I miss.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: And 'cause I have to count all these boats, then check and double-check the numbers, I now have no time to work on my poetry... It is really ruining my day!

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: ...I know! Maybe you can help me count up yesterday's boats? I need to know how many came in and how many went out.

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: ...I was supposed to have a colleague helping, but...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Ooh, ooh, I have an idea! There's these three kids who I always see playing down by the docks.

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: I bet you they'll remember how many boats came and went yesterday...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: That said, they are only kids. So to be on the safe side, you should ask all three of them and check their stories match.

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Well then. I will leave you to interrogate the minors and report back to me when you're done. Over and out.

choices.text: As long as it's ten or under...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Oh please! You have toes, don't you? Anything up to and including twenty and you have no grounds to complain!

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: I know I can count on you!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: What are we gonna play today...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Hello! What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Cast your mind back to yesterday...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Yesterday? Hmm... I only remember <color=#00E1FFFF>one big boat came in yesterday morning</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Fei said it was definitely a Millelith boat and Meng thought it might be a cargo boat.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: But I think it looked so amazing it must have been a Liyue Qixing boat.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Will you remember? ...You know what, let me <color=#00E1FFFF>write that down</color> for you.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Isn't my handwriting really good? Here you go — and make sure you don't lose it!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Boys are so dumb...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Oh, hi! What're you up to?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm just here to ask a few questions...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Erm... I can't remember. Wait... I think <color=#00E1FFFF>two boats came in yesterday morning</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: They were only small boats and they didn't look like most of the ones in the city...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Will you remember? ...You know what, let me <color=#00E1FFFF>write that down</color> for you.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Isn't my handwriting really good? Here you go — and make sure you don't lose it!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Hello! Have you come to play with us?

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: ...You're not here to play games, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here about what you saw yesterday...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Yesterday? <color=#00E1FFFF>No boats came in or went out yesterday morning</color>, so the men who work at the docks had nothing to do.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: But they still didn't go home. They just kept waiting at the docks all day long.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: I don't get it. If they didn't have any work, why didn't they just go home? It's so weird...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Will you remember? ...You know what, let me <color=#00E1FFFF>write that down</color> for you.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Isn't my handwriting really good? Here you go — and make sure you don't lose it!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: I'm never gonna get to be the captain...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Hi! Are you looking for me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How well do you remember yesterday...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Erm, I wasn't really paying attention. I just remember that <color=#00E1FFFF>one big boat went out yesterday at noon</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: You wanna know why I only remember what happened at noon?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Meng and Lulu went to buy Lotus Heads yesterday at noon. I stayed here on my own to guard our spot.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Of course I had to guard our spot. Otherwise someone might steal it!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: What's wrong? You look confused.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: That's all I remember. ...Oh, go on then, I'll <color=#00E1FFFF>put it in writing</color> for you.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: But don't blame me if something goes wrong. My memory is not so good...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: What're we playing today?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Oh hi. What's up?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sir, I just have a few questions...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Two boats came in yesterday at lunchtime</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: They were both going really fast. I bet it was an emergency delivery.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: That's all I remember. ...Oh, go on then, I'll <color=#00E1FFFF>put it in writing</color> for you.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: But don't blame me if something goes wrong. My memory is not so good...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Hmph, when will it be my turn...

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Oh. Hi. Are you looking for me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Boats. Yesterday. What can you tell me?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: I don't really remember. No wait... I did notice <color=#00E1FFFF>3 boats came in yesterday at noon</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: And then loads of people went over to unload all the stuff... The sailors made us get out of the way.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: That's all I remember. ...Oh, go on then, I'll <color=#00E1FFFF>put it in writing</color> for you.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: But don't blame me if something goes wrong. My memory is not so good...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I can't wait till I'm a grown up...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Oh hi. You need something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need to know what you witnessed yesterday...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: The boats? If I remember right, <color=#00E1FFFF>no boats came in or went out yesterday evening</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: And I have a good memory. I know what I saw.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Here, take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Note</color>. Consider it my written testimony. Don't lose it now!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Just like my daddy always says, a word in the head is worth two in the brush! Wait... no, that's not it...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: When I grow up, I wanna travel the whole world...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Oh, hello. What're you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need to know what you saw yesterday...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Yesterday... Uh... I'm sorry, I just remember <color=#00E1FFFF>1 boat went out yesterday evening</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Yesterday morning I went to go pick some Lotus Heads for Lulu and Fei.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: But I lost track of time and it was already evening when I got back...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I don't think it was a waste though. 'Cause Lulu and Fei got to eat Lotus Heads, didn't they?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Here, take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Note</color>. Consider it my written testimony. Don't lose it now!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Just like my daddy always says, a word in the head is worth two in the brush! Wait... no, that's not it...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I wish there was a way I could grow up faster...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Hello! What are you doing today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Counting boats. About that...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Hmm, lemme think... I just remember <color=#00E1FFFF>3 boats came in yesterday evening</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: The boats had really bright lights on, and there were loads of people at the dock. I think they were all waiting for those boats.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Lulu and Fei went home, but I stayed to watch those boats for ages.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: If you could get on a boat like that... Surely you could go anywhere you wanted to...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Here, take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Note</color>. Consider it my written testimony. Don't lose it now!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Just like my daddy always says, a word in the head is worth two in the brush! Wait... no, that's not it...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: 7 boats entered the docks? Hmm... Y'know what, I think that sounds about right!

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Thanks so much! Here's a little something for your trouble, detective!

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Right. Now that's sorted, it's time to get back to my magnum opus...

dialogues.speaker: Linling

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: I can't afford to lose this job... I don't know what I would do...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Please, rack your brains! You absolutely have to remember!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Didn't those kids each write a <color=#00E1FFFF>Note</color> about the boats they saw?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you're in a forgetful mood, just get the <color=#00E1FFFF>Notes</color> out and have another look through them.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: You don't remember? But I wrote it on a Note for you. Don't you even remember that?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Everything I remember is written on that Note I gave you. If you don't remember, read it!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
